matches: README.md:66:      var result = i18n.__( {phrase: phrase, locale: locale} );

README.md:99:It is possible that you might invoke `i18n.__` before the translation map was loaded from the server. This will cause an error message to be written to your console, telling you that you need to call `ensureLocaleIsLoaded`.

README.md:103:`ensureLocaleIsLoaded` returns a promise. So you can simply wrap the call around your use of `i18n.__` or include the call earlier in your load hierarchy. Whatever suits your needs best.
